title: チャンピオンズCにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the Champions Cup arrives. Chukyo Racecourse, which also hosts popular turf races, is just under maximum capacity.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon has rediscovered her original dream of simply shining, but she appears nervous. I let her know that she'll be all right.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She decides to shine as bright as she can. Holding that feeling close to her chest, Smart Falcon heads to the track.
